sources_swept.data_integrity_flag: Zinc pigment row prints 86.84 kg / 1900.0 lb. 1900 lb x 0.453592 kg/lb = 861.82 kg, a ~9.9x mismatch against the printed 86.84 kg. Every other row in the same table converts consistently (epoxy resin 190.0lb->86.18kg matches printed 86.18kg exactly; naphtha 123.0lb->55.79kg matches; paint thinner 58.7lb->26.62kg matches printed 26.63kg within rounding). This isolates the zinc-pigment row as an internal inconsistency in the primary document (not introduced by this fire's extraction -- pdftotext -layout output checked verbatim). Filed as proposed_followup 2.
